items.question: What is Milo’s Cafe known for?
items.answer: Focaccia sandwiches, espresso, and sweet and savory crepes. News & Observer readers voted Milo’s the Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle in 2026. [Read the coverage.](https://www.newsobserver.com/living/food-drink/article315186505.html)

items.question: Where is Milo’s Cafe?
items.answer: Milo’s Cafe is at 10119 Chapel Hill Rd, Morrisville, NC 27560.

items.question: What does Milo’s Cafe serve?
items.answer: Lavazza espresso and coffee drinks, matcha, specialty lattes and teas, plus focaccia sandwiches, salads, toast and bowls, and sweet or savory crepes, all made from scratch.

items.question: Can I order online for pickup or delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Order through our online ordering page for pickup, curbside or delivery, or come in and dine with us.

items.question: Is there outdoor seating?
items.answer: Yes. We have indoor seating and a patio with bistro chairs and shaded tables.

items.question: Do you have vegetarian options?
items.answer: Yes, including avocado toast, goat cheese toast, veggie focaccia and several crepes. Please ask us about ingredients and allergens.
